# MutualCS

## What We Do
MutualCS is a specialist tech and executive search firm. We recruit permanent tech talent and C-suite leaders for high-growth companies and Global Capability Centers (GCCs), globally. No staffing or contracting — permanent placement only.

## Services
- Executive Search: CXO, VP, Country Head, CHRO, CISO, Board — retained search, global mandates
- Tech Recruitment: Engineers, architects, data scientists — permanent placement, any country
- GCC Recruitment: End-to-end talent acquisition for companies building India Global Capability Centers
- Embedded RPO: Dedicated recruiter embedded in client hiring process

## Roles We Place
AI/ML Engineers, GenAI Architects, Platform & Cloud Engineers, Data Engineering leads, Cybersecurity professionals, FinTech engineers, Embedded & ADAS Engineers, Full-Stack & Backend Engineers, Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, CEO/MD, CTO/CIO, CFO, CHRO, CISO, VP Engineering, VP Product, Country Head, GCC Site Director, Board Member, Independent Director

## Clients
Global Capability Centers, Fortune 500 enterprises, Series B–D startups, financial institutions, technology companies — headquartered in the US, UK, Singapore, Japan, Middle East, and Europe.

## Differentiators
- 30-day shortlist SLA with contractual 20% fee-back if missed
- 85%+ first-year retention rate
- Passive headhunting — not job board sourcing
- Permanent placement only — no staffing or contracting
- Operates globally with deep expertise in India's engineering talent market
